paper_metadata.title: Effects of Nb and Ta additions on the strength and coarsening resistance of precipitation-strengthened Al-Zr-Sc-Er-Si alloys

attributes.composition: Er- and Sc-rich core, Zr-rich shell enriched in Nb (locally up to 0.3 at.%)

evidence.quote: for alloy Q4 aged for 200 h (compared to 24 h for alloy Q2) the Zr-rich shell is also enriched in Nb, whose concentration reaches locally 0.3 at.%
